entries.0d6982e3f1031af5: This is a business segment not included in reportable segments, covering domestic manufacture and sale of nonwoven fabrics and paper-container machinery, transportation, insurance agency, leasing and real estate businesses. Nonwoven fabrics are made by Rengo Nonwoven Products Co., Ltd., and paper-container machinery by Yamada Machinery Industry Co., Ltd. and others, and the company also only sells paper-container machinery. Transportation, insurance agency, leasing and real estate businesses are handled by Rengo Logistics Co., Ltd., Sanyo Jidosha Unso Co., Ltd. and others. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥39,425 million (previous year: ¥38,844 million; 101.5% year on year); the company states that revenue increased, with a price revision in the transportation business contributing. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 2,498.
entries.1a1cda8d8ddf5bf5: A business that manufactures and sells heavy packaging products in Japan, carried out by Nihon Matai Co., Ltd. and others. Nihon Matai Co., Ltd. is a consolidated subsidiary with 100.00% of voting rights, and in the status of affiliated companies it is listed as a business in both this segment and "Other Businesses." Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥46,419 million (previous year: ¥44,977 million; 103.2% year on year), the fourth largest. The company states that revenue increased, with a revision of product prices contributing. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 808. The specific products within heavy packaging products are not described in the business description.
entries.3bb920cc82a05b79: Paperboard and Paper Processing Related Business
entries.9a864a55009ec8bc: A business that manufactures and sells paperboard, corrugated board, corrugated boxes, flexible packaging products, heavy packaging products and nonwoven fabrics overseas. Paperboard is produced by Vina Kraft Paper (Vietnam; equity-method affiliate with 30.00% of voting rights) and others; corrugated board and corrugated boxes by Dalian Lianhe Packaging Products Co., Ltd. and others; flexible packaging products by Jiangsu Zhongjin Mata Pharmaceutical Packaging Co., Ltd. and others; heavy packaging products by TriWall and others; and nonwoven fabrics by Wuxi Lianhe Packaging Co., Ltd. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥209,092 million (previous year: ¥213,094 million; 98.1% year on year), the second largest. This is the only one of the five categories whose sales declined from the previous year. Overseas production volumes were 240 million m² for corrugated board and 225 million m² for corrugated boxes. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 10,237, the largest of the five categories.
entries.b85f96c003a8883c: A business that manufactures and sells flexible packaging products and cellophane in Japan.
entries.bb6542305c17aaf5: A business that manufactures and sells paperboard, corrugated board, corrugated boxes and kraft pulp in Japan; it is the largest segment at Rengo Co., Ltd. Paperboard is made by the company, Marusan Seishi Co., Ltd. and others, and is sold through its own sales channels, including Rengo Paper Business Co., Ltd.; it is also supplied within the group as the main raw material for corrugated board. Corrugated board and corrugated boxes are handled independently by the company, Daiwa Shiki Co., Ltd., Setsu Carton Co., Ltd. and others, and the company and Rengo Riverwood Packaging Co., Ltd. also manufacture and sell multipacks used for six-can packs of canned beer and similar products. Kraft pulp is handled by Daiko Seishi Co., Ltd. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥521,869 million (previous year: ¥514,720 million; 101.4% year on year), the largest of the five categories. The company states that revenue increased, with a revision of product prices contributing. Production volumes were 2,481 thousand t for paperboard, 4,231 million m² for corrugated board and 3,597 million m² for corrugated boxes. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 9,066.
entries.d8629ed7aa147da0: A business that manufactures and sells paperboard, corrugated board, corrugated boxes and kraft pulp in Japan; it is the largest segment at Rengo Co., Ltd.
entries.e7e74bed9a6f2e92: A business that manufactures and sells paperboard, corrugated board, corrugated boxes, flexible packaging products, heavy packaging products and nonwoven fabrics overseas.
entries.eabcacc2dabfa51a: A company that makes and sells packaging materials in Japan and overseas, centered on corrugated cardboard and ranging from paperboard to flexible packaging and heavy-duty packaging.
entries.f7728a2b0ed5baad: A business that manufactures and sells flexible packaging products and cellophane in Japan. Flexible packaging products are manufactured and sold by Howa Sangyo Co., Ltd., RM Tohcello Co., Ltd. (a consolidated subsidiary with 51.00% of voting rights) and others, while the company only sells them. The company manufactures and sells cellophane. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥191,529 million (previous year: ¥181,614 million; 105.5% year on year), the third largest. The company states that revenue increased due to revised product prices and higher sales volumes. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 2,964.
